findings.text: Medium: the rollback in ensureIgnored restores the .gitignore bytes read earlier (or unlinks it) without checking it is still the file this run wrote, so a concurrent edit between write and check-ignore is clobbered. Narrow window; compare content before restoring.

Low: core.excludesFile=/dev/null (global config unread) means a file ignored only globally looks not-ignored, so the write is refused after the line is added and rolled back. Safe direction (harmless refusal); worth one line in the README/message.
